environment.browser: the developer's own Chrome, attached over CDP at 127.0.0.1:9222
environment.model: none on the verdict path; the assertion draft is offline-optional

commands: # click the submit button, annotate it in Chinese, accept the drafted assertion
limitations: Chromium only: Nodepact talks CDP to a browser the developer already started; it never launches one.
It judges, it does not fix: no DOM or source edits, no auto-repair.
Three assertion kinds only (gap, style, changed); no layout-tree reasoning.
No CI mode and no headless run: the baseline is a crop of one developer's own window, so it is not committed to the repository.
The baseline crop is machine specific: .nodepact/ is git-ignored and re-created by `nodepact annotate`.
The model ids in configs/nodepact.yaml come from each vendor's console and are not verified by an API call; GLM's OpenAI-compatible base_url is left empty because it differs per deployment.
The demo numbers above come from one machine at devicePixelRatio 1 with capture_scale 1; a different DPR changes the crop size, not the verdict.
